scope: Single finite display and physical-explanation addendum review; 35 revised designs, 70 PNG/PDF files, nine equation groups and 53 figure interpretations. Existing scientific decisions preserved.
review_policy: physmath-research-loop 1.3 C9 finite changed-surface review; no recursive review or numerical rerun

checks.visual_hashes: All 70 actual bytes equal after_sha256 in DISPLAY_REVISION_RECEIPT.json.
checks.caption_join: All 53 distinct caption keys exactly equal the 53 ATLAS_INDEX png keys, comprising 35 new and 18 historical designs.
checks.reference_clocks: Read both saved zero-anchor NPZ histories independently: z strictly decreases, elapsed Myr strictly increases; all saved knot interpolation roundtrip residual 0. Base endpoints 0 and 3092.6162048482947 Myr; strong endpoints 0 and 3230.381131592942 Myr. Displayed five top tick values reproduce rounded interpolated values.
checks.axis_implementation: Direct log10 abundance coordinates with 10^k tick formatting; no second logarithm or exp underflow. Signed values retained with symlog and stated linear threshold; nonnegative zero samples omitted/annotated on log ordinate. Each time curve retains its own elapsed_s converted using 365.25 days/year. Top axes use explicitly named reference clocks with ticks within reference support.
checks.visual_review: Five revised PNG designs inspected directly: isotope total z, ionic elapsed Myr, weak signed fraction difference, strong signed control, strong signed stress/positive norms/time. No blocking clipping/label overlap observed; top axes and figure reference notes readable.
checks.equation_explanations: Per-volume density-squared versus per-baryon density scaling, identical-pair half factor, isotope/charge distinction, atomic electron feedback, Coulomb/Maxwell Gamow continuation, neutral 1/v scaling, binary detailed balance versus photon ensemble, source/stock distinction, decay/QSS limits, prescribed gas temperature versus massive momentum scale, and local quadratic response are stated with appropriate model limits.
checks.caption_claim_boundaries: Historical atomic-only T/n zeros remain historical, new T/n totals are conditional and charge-unresolved, old cold response is unresolved, strong response separates from observed controls without a certified error bound, nuclear photon zero is tied to prescribed cutoff/target approximation, and no empirical or observational validity is inferred.
checks.canonical_metadata_references: CASE_TABLE.csv and GROUP_METRICS.json exist and manuscript references are current.

withdrawn_candidate.observation: Inherited earlier notes suggested obsolete filenames; a direct current filesystem check disproved that candidate. Both named canonical files exist.
withdrawn_candidate.impact: None; no manuscript repair requested after correction.

executions.numeric_work: Read-only saved arrays and metadata/hash checks only.

publication_status.combined_pdf_layout: Separate parent visual publication gate; not certified by this addendum.

claim_limits: No all-possible-reaction or full production-network admission.
No rigorous global numerical error bound, statistical confidence or empirical low-temperature nuclear validation.
Reference top axes do not represent every trajectory clock.
Nine equation groups explain the updated dossier; this is not a line-by-line review of all equations in three source volumes.
Representative PNG review does not certify final combined PDF pagination or typesetting.
